data.title: Mon3tr · 适合喝的温度
data.description: 她看了看温度计，等茶稍微凉一些，才将杯子推给坐在对面的朋友。
data.camera: 中景，茶杯与温度计清晰
data.promptProse: Resting her arms on a clean counter beside a steaming porcelain teacup, Mon3tr leans in slightly to watch the rising vapor with curious green eyes under soft laboratory lighting.
data.animaCaption: Resting her arms on a clean counter beside a steaming porcelain teacup, she leans slightly forward to watch the curling vapor with curious eyes. Soft interior laboratory light highlights the delicate steam rising between them.
